Date January 31, 1939.

Subject Hwa Lien Club - Censorship of 14 plays.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford D.J.

（批：Translation attached. D.B.Z.）
（批：C.D.S.S.L. ... K.Kao ...）
（批：Also see S.P. 76）
（批：* Also see S.P. 50）
（批：D.B.Z. F.A. 50 3/1）

With reference to the letters from the Hwa Lien Club, dated December 16, 22 and 28, 1938, requesting the Police to censor 14 plays which the Dramatic Section intend staging, the dialogues of each play have been examined and found to contain nothing of an objectionable nature, with the exception of one play entitled "The Rising of the Moon" (明月東升) (Classified as No.12). This play was censored by S. 3 and approved for exhibition, subject to deletions (Files S.P. 39, 49 and 78).

Hereunder is a list of the fourteen plays censored :-

1. The Pitiful "Becca". (可憐的裴迦).
2. Tragedy on the Lake. (湖上的悲劇).
3. The object of living. (生之意志).
4. Proposal. (求婚).
5. A bee. (一隻馬蜂).
6. Before Breakfast. (早點前).
7. Red Lantern. (紅燈籠).
8. King Pao (name of a child) (金寶).
9. Feng Woo Wai (a district in Shanse). (汾河灣).
10. Understanding. (also known as "Cold Rice") (悟 (冷飯)).
* 11. Mother's Dream. (母親的夢).
12. Rising of the Moon. (明月東升).
13. Men. (男人).
14. Room to let (出租).

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（批注：* 另见 S.P. 50）
（批注：D.B.Z. F.A. 50 3/1）

关于华联剧社于1938年12月16日、22日和28日来信，请求警方审查戏剧组拟上演的14部剧目一事，经检查每部剧目的对白，除名为《明月东升》（The Rising of the Moon）（列为第12号）的一部外，未发现任何令人反感的内容。该剧已由S. 3科审查并批准上演，但须删减部分内容（参见档案 S.P. 39、49 和 78）。

以下是经审查的十四部剧目清单：-

1. 《可怜的裴迦》(The Pitiful "Becca")。
2. 《湖上的悲剧》(Tragedy on the Lake)。
3. 《生之意志》(The object of living)。
4. 《求婚》(Proposal)。
5. 《一只马蜂》(A bee)。
6. 《早点前》(Before Breakfast)。
7. 《红灯笼》(Red Lantern)。
8. 《金宝》(King Pao (儿童名))。
9. 《汾河湾》(Feng Woo Wai (山西一地区))。
10. 《悟》（又名《冷饭》）(Understanding (also known as "Cold Rice"))。
* 11. 《母亲的梦》(Mother's Dream)。
12. 《明月东升》(Rising of the Moon)。
13. 《男人》(Men)。
14. 《出租》(Room to let)。

高延肯
副督察

助理总监（特务科）。

Made by. D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken    Forwarded by. C. G...

The Shanghai Chin Woo Athletic Association,
2nd floor, Lane 353, 1 Nanking Road, is arranging
to hold a social meeting of members in the Christian
Joint Universities, Room 450, Lane 353, 1 Nanking
Road, between 1 p.m. and 8 p.m., November 26. It
is expected that 1,000 members will be present.
Admission will be free of charge.

The programme of the scheduled meeting will
consist of :-
1. Chinese boxing.
2. Music.
3. Teiping Style plays.
4. A modern drama entitled "A cup of milk"
(一杯牛奶).

The programme has been studied and is found to
contain nothing of an objectionable nature. Huang
Vee-ching (黃維慶), Chief Secretary of the
association, was, however, interviewed on November
24 and warned against introducing anything touching
on politics. He gave an assurance that the
instructions would be observed.

静安寺路

上海大学文学社（圆明园路209号）拟于1939年12月27日晚7时30分，在静安寺路 (Bubbling Well Road) 999号男青年会 (Y.M.C.A.) 大楼举行音乐会及戏剧演出，以庆祝圣诞节。节目包括以下内容：
(1) 音乐会（小提琴和钢琴演奏）。
(2) 上演以下剧目：
(a) 《锦囊妙计》。
(b) 《两间患难朋友》。
(c) 《校长室》。
本股已审查剧目剧情简介，未发现含有任何令人反感的内容。

关于此次活动，上海大学文学社负责人梁國鏞 (Liang Kuo Yung) 和胡國城 (Joo Kuo Zung) 两位先生于12月23日上午在警察总局接受约谈，并被警告不得在活动中引入任何令人反感或具有政治性质的内容。
